title: Annotatio V §.III: still Capernaite; Oral preached supernatural/sacramental — three Eucharistic species
pass_a_gloss: (2) While still thus not every appearance of Capernaite Eating — at least partial — is abolished, nay rather shines clearly enough, they preach their Oral Eating of Christ’s Body as Supernatural and Sacramental, and by this pact inculcate in the Sacred Supper altogether three modes of Eating, or three Species of Eucharistic Eating: the Corporal of bread and merely Physical; the Corporal or Oral of Christ’s Body, which is also supernatural and sacramental; and finally the Spiritual not so much of Christ’s body as of its fruits and efficacy.
pass_b_english: Even so a Capernaite look (at least partial) still shows clearly. They then preach that Oral eating as Supernatural and Sacramental.
Result: three Eucharistic species — merely physical of bread; corporal/oral of Christ’s Body (also supernatural/sacramental); spiritual not so much of the body as of its fruits and efficacy.
source_text: (2) Dùm adhuc sic Capernaiticæ Manducationis, saltem partialis, species non omnis abolita, imò verò satis clarè pellucet, Oralem Corporis Christi Manducationem suam, Supernaturalem prædicant & Sacramentalem, hôc pactò in universum tres in Cœna sacra Manducandi modos, seu Manducationis Eucharisticæ tres Species, inculcantes. Corporalem panis meréque Physicam; Corporalem seu Oralem Corporis Christi, quæ etiam sit supernaturalis & sacramentalis; denique Spiritualem non tàm corporis Christi, quam fructuum & efficaciæ hujus.
